title: Normalize synthetic Gmail message metadata
objective: Repair normalize_message so the Gmail-like synthetic fixture is converted into the fixed provider-neutral shape. Read headers case-insensitively and preserve only the fields required by the acceptance test. Do not change the fixture or test.
acceptance_criteria: provider and thread identifiers are preserved
From, To, Subject, Reply-To, Return-Path, List-ID, and Authentication-Results headers are normalized
label IDs and snippet are preserved
the fixed acceptance test passes without modifying fixture or test
